copy.title: The Kardashian Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Kim Kardashian’s family: SKIMS, Kylie Cosmetics and the Coty deals, the other family brands, the homes, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #017 · The Kardashian family · Data as of
copy.h1: The reality show became a billion-dollar business. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them owns, the one family brand you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. Kim’s children are listed by first name only.
copy.investLede: None of the family’s own companies trade on the stock market. The one ticker on the map is Coty, which owns 51% of Kylie Cosmetics.
copy.moneyLede: Kim’s fortune is mostly her stake in SKIMS. Three people on the map have a published Forbes net worth.
copy.homesLede: The biggest home deals on the map, as reported: Kim’s and Kanye’s in Malibu, Kylie’s in Los Angeles. Prices are what they paid. No street addresses here.
copy.homesFlipLabel: What they paid for these three
copy.homesChart: Each house: what they paid (and Kanye’s sale)
copy.recordLede: The money that shows up in company filings, funding rounds and the divorce settlement. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From a 2007 reality show to a $5 billion clothing company.
copy.calcYearsK: Years to earn what Kim has

summary.t: Reality-TV star turned founder. Most of her fortune is her stake in SKIMS, the shapewear and clothing company she started in 2019. Forbes first counted her as a billionaire in April 2021.

owns.t: Co-founded in 2019 with Jens and Emma Grede. Forbes estimated in 2023 that she owns at least a third. Valued at $5 billion after a $225 million round in November 2025.
Private equity firm she launched in 2022 with Jay Sammons, formerly of Carlyle. Kris is a partner.

record.t: Forbes first valued her at $1 billion in April 2021, mostly from her stakes in KKW Beauty and SKIMS.
Sold 20% of her beauty business to Coty for $200 million in 2020, a $1 billion valuation. She later relaunched the line as SKKN by Kim, and Coty sold its stake to SKIMS in March 2025.
Under the November 2022 settlement, Kanye pays $200,000 a month in child support, and they split the costs of the children’s schools, college and security. Neither pays spousal support.

facts.t: SKIMS expected more than $1 billion in net sales in 2025, Bloomberg reported.
Bought an oceanfront Malibu estate once owned by Cindy Crawford for $70.4 million in 2022.

kidsNote.t: Kim and Kanye have four children. We list their first names only.

summary.t: Rapper and designer who now goes by Ye. Adidas ended its Yeezy partnership with him in October 2022, citing his antisemitic remarks. Forbes then cut its estimate of his fortune to $400 million.

owns.t: About 5% of his ex-wife’s company, Forbes estimates.
His fashion brand. Forbes had valued the Adidas deal at $1.5 billion before Adidas ended it in 2022.

record.t: Pays $200,000 a month under the November 2022 divorce settlement.
Was on Forbes’s 2022 billionaires list. Without the Adidas deal, Forbes puts him at $400 million.

facts.t: Bought a Malibu house designed by Tadao Ando for $57.3 million in 2021 and sold it for $21 million in 2024.

summary.t: Los Angeles lawyer and businessman. Co-founded the music trade paper Radio & Records in 1973 and sold it in 1979. Was a volunteer member of O.J. Simpson’s legal team. Married Kris from 1978 to 1991. He died in 2003.
Runs the business side of the family and was behind Keeping Up with the Kardashians. Forbes says she takes a 10% cut of what her children earn from modeling, licensing and their beauty companies.

owns.t: Co-created the cleaning-products brand in 2021 with Emma Grede and Chrissy Teigen. Forbes estimated her stake at 7%.
Partner in Kim’s private equity firm.

record.t: Forbes put her net worth at $200 million in October 2022. Her Forbes profile now shows no figure.

facts.t: Was a flight attendant in the 1970s before marrying Robert Kardashian.

summary.t: Won the 1976 Olympic decathlon in Montreal with a world-record score. Married to Kris from 1991 to 2015; they are Kendall and Kylie’s parents. Ran for governor in California’s 2021 recall election and finished 13th.
The eldest of Robert and Kris’s four children. Started the lifestyle site Poosh in 2019 and the supplement brand Lemme in 2022. Married Travis Barker in 2022.

owns.t: Launched in September 2022. It made more than $30 million in sales in its first 16 months, Forbes Argentina reported.
Launched in March 2019 as a lifestyle website.

summary.t: Co-founded the clothing brand Good American with Emma Grede in 2016. Launched the protein-popcorn brand Khloud in 2025.

owns.t: Co-founder. The brand made $1 million in sales on its first day.

summary.t: The youngest of Robert and Kris’s four children. Graduated from USC’s Marshall School of Business in 2009 and launched the sock line Arthur George in 2012.
Model. Forbes named her the world’s highest-paid model in 2017. Launched 818 Tequila in 2021.

owns.t: Launched in May 2021. Kris put her own money into it, Forbes reported.

summary.t: Started Kylie Cosmetics with lip kits in 2015 and sold 51% of it to Coty for $600 million. Launched the clothing line Khy in 2024.

owns.t: Founded in 2015 with $250,000 of her modeling earnings. Coty bought 51% in a deal that closed in January 2020. Forbes estimates she still owns about 44%.

record.t: Coty paid $600 million for 51% of Kylie Cosmetics, which had about $177 million in net revenue over the prior 12 months. Forbes estimates she took home about $540 million before taxes.
Forbes called her a billionaire in 2019 and stopped counting her as one in 2020.
Bloomberg reported in 2023 that she had explored buying back Coty’s stake, and that the two sides disagreed on price.

facts.t: Bought a Holmby Hills, Los Angeles, estate for $36.5 million in 2020.
